_note: Search terms and match words for stock photos from Openverse (openly licensed). `must` = at least one of these words has to appear in a photo's title or tags, so off-topic hits are skipped. Run `node scripts/fetch-photos.mjs`. The first run pins the chosen photos in `picks`, so later runs download exactly the same ones. To swap a photo: delete that entry's `picks`, edit `query`/`must`, rerun. These are PLACEHOLDERS: replace them with the store's own product photos before launch (see src/config/images.ts).
